    • getAttribute

      public String getAttribute(String name, String defaultValue, String prefix, String suffix)
      Get the value of attribute but instead fo dumping an exception, show a default value if it doesn't exist. Only if it exists, show it with a prefix and a suffix. This could be useful for showing comma separated lists, etc, where you only show the comma if the element exists.
      Specified by:
      getAttribute in interface AttributedBean
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the attribute
      defaultValue - The default value to show
      prefix - Prefix to show before the field value.
      suffix - Suffix to show after the field value.
      Returns:
      value of attribute, with prefix and suffix appended if the value is not the default.
